title: the_babysitting_invoice
display_title: My brother-in-law 'forgot' to pay me for babysitting, so I sent him an invoice he couldn't ignore
beats: My brother-in-law (36M) owes me (26F) four months of babysitting money, and I finally billed him like a business.
He kept saying 'family doesn't charge family' while I missed shifts at my actual job to cover his kids.
So I made a real invoice, itemized, with late fees, and emailed it from an account called Reliable Sitting Services LLC.
He panicked and tried paying me quietly in cash before his wife saw the email in their shared inbox.
Too late. She saw it first, saw the four months, and asked him why a stranger's business had been raising her kids for free.
He paid me in full by that night, plus the late fees. Was I wrong?
